_meta.note: controllers.ZC1: Zone A is the prototype rig's Zone 1, the actuator box (farm details form, R-1, sections 5 and 7): N, P and K on IN1-IN3 (GPIO14, 27, 26) are relay1-relay3; IN4 (GPIO25) is the water inlet. controllers.ZC2: Zone B is the rig's Zone 2, the gateway's own relay board (snm-prototype-extension-v1 gateway README): N, P and K on IN1-IN3 (GPIO39, 40, 41) are relay1-relay3; IN4 (GPIO42) is the solenoid valve that fills the Zone B tank. Its pumps run at their own rate (hardware.json pumps.zones.Z2). Both zones' TDS probes use the 0.5 factor (500 scale: the sensor box's and the gateway's firmware both multiply by 0.5). The drums have no level sensors. gateway is the firmware's default name (MG_GATEWAY_NAME, gateway-01) for the team to confirm.
